title: Countries with Red, White, and Black Flags

sources.name: Flags and Anthems of the World - Britannica
List of Flags by Color Combination - Wiki

_: Three equal horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black, with a golden eagle-and-shield coat of arms (the Egyptian eagle of Saladin) in the center. Similar to Iraq, Syria, and Yemen.
Three equal horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black, overlaid with a green triangle oriented along the left/hoist edge.
Three equal horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black, with green Kufic script in the center saying "God is the greatest" in Arabic. Similar to Egypt, Syria, and Yemen.
Three equal horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black. Similar to Egypt, Iraq, and Syria.
Three equal horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black, with two green five-pointed stars in the center. Similar to Egypt, Iraq, and Yemen.
Red field with a single black stripe edged in white running diagonally from the upper left/hoist edge to the lower right/fly edge.
